decisions.statement: A readout that takes its own reading holds the code taking it beside its page.
A readout carried its reading from elsewhere holds no code.
A readout names its scale rather than carrying a scale.
A readout names the fact that earns a color rather than naming the color.
Which color is earned belongs to the scale rather than to the readout.
A readout has its label and unit.
A readout has nothing about how the label and unit are drawn.
A readout has one place whatever groups draw the readout.
The place a readout has is where that readout sits rather than how wide its figure is.
A readout states whether anything draws the readout.
The reading a readout last took is carried outside the commit.
When a readout began answering nothing is carried outside the commit.
A readout answering nothing keeps the reading it last took.
Everything a readout shows is stated on the readout.
Where and how big is the display's.
A readout keeps the last body the readout was given when its feed stops.
A readout drops that body when the feed refuses.
A row a readout cannot read costs that row's own reading alone.
Readouts refresh on schedules of their own.
Two readouts can disagree about one number at one moment.
A readout's color tracks progress toward done.
A status badge's color tracks kind.
A readout leaves out everything but the reading itself.
A readout draws however many readings its feed sends.
A feed sending no reading is the single feed a readout refuses.
The store answers with numbers.
Every color is worked out outside the store.
A readout is read rather than interrogated.
The reading a readout's reader wants from that readout costs one glance.
A reader sorts nothing to read a readout.
A reader does no arithmetic to read a readout.
A reader recalls nothing to read a readout.
A readout's reader is never the instrument that catches that readout being wrong.
Every key a feed sends is decoded by the tile reading that feed.
Every readout a group draws keeps its last reading beside its own page.
Every readout that takes a reading names a group that draws the reading.

definition: one reading a person is shown

directives.name: Field Retirement
directives.act: Drop a field from a readout before its feed stops sending that field.
directives.warrant: A shipped build reads the payload that build was made against, and nothing reports a stranded tile.
aids: Wait for the old build to leave every device.
Treat a rename or an emptied key as a drop.

directives.name: Device Conditions
directives.act: Draw a readout in its instrument under the conditions the device draws that readout under.
directives.warrant: A tile that clips on the phone passes in the instrument's own frame, so a reader finds it first.
aids: Replace the references taken in the old frame.
Match the text size and the dark setting too.
